summary:
plan.md is written; I checked block names with `mcd blocks --check` but rendered and built nothing. It's two identical 3-storey brick barracks under 45° red granite hipped roofs (peak at y 13) with 4 dormers each. Each has a full-length white two-storey porch facing south, with diorite-wall posts, a gallery and white trim, and a central slab ramp; the museum also gets red DISNEY/MUSEUM banners and a dark glass pavilion behind.
The white-stucco Officers' Club has red-tile roofs at three heights, a front cross gable with a round window, a white arcade, deep-set windows behind iron bars, cannons and a courtyard. The 1½-storey brick Visitor Center has a hipped roof, dormer, white-post porch, a red PRESIDIO sign band and a flagpole.
Two changes from the brief: the y 13 height cap keeps the brick chimneys below the roof ridge, so they rise from the back slope, and the raised-basement windows are dropped in favour of a stone base course. Four modules square to the grid, south fronts: red-brick three-storey barracks (museum and Montgomery St.) with granite-red hips, brick dormers, white two-storey porches and red banners; the white-stucco Officers' Club with cross-gables, oculus, arcades and cannons; the brick Visitor Center with a red sign and flagpole.
Six parts: shells, club, roofs, porches, fittings and signs, grounds and light. elements.md and plan.md sections are written; every block id is checked against 1.21.1.

Brick shells and pavilion: parts/shells.mjs builds the brick shells (museum, barracks with two wings, Visitor Center), the cornices, the museum glass pavilion and the y0 ground courses. Every opening from OPENINGS is left air. make.sh runs with no refused writes and no off-palette blocks from this part; `mcd check` reports no floating or unsupported blocks. I did not render the build or run `mcd fit`.
polish: The barracks wings have their own south wall at z5, next to the main block's north wall at z6, so there is no interior doorway between wing and main block (brickBlock only writes into air).
The Visitor Center, barracks wings and museum ends have no extra basement windows. The wing roofs reach up to y10 (wing walls to y6).
Not done: the elements.md ticks, and a render check of the tiles. The only tick written is the P1 box in plan.md.
roof.json produces off-palette deepslate, tuff-brick and cobbled-deepslate stairs, which is P3's to fix.

Brick shells and pavilion: still OFF-PALETTE: deepslate_tile_stairs x32 (roof.json), tuff_brick_stairs x56 (roof.json), cobbled_deepslate_stairs x45 (roof.json), polished_deepslate_stairs x15 (roof.json)

waste.what: Opening cells (windows, doors, transoms) written out by hand as [x,y,z] hole lists, per face
waste.cost: about 10 hole lists, built with two local helpers
waste.tool: brickBlock option accepting a window grid, e.g. {face, xs, storeys}, or reading OPENINGS from a data file

companions.task: quoins, window lintels and the basement-course small windows

summary:
Officers' Club shell: Officers' Club shell built in parts/club.mjs: ground courses, 2-thick stucco range/gable front and 1-thick wings, courtyard paving with back wall and arched gate, arcade piers/arches with x58/x68 heads, entrance arch (keystone and stairs at y3), and oculus at (63,8,21).
All reserved windows, doors and the entrance door cell are left air. make.sh saves a whole build.nbt: the club line shows 1515 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE, and check reports 0 floating/unsupported/orphans; fit is OK.
Plan.md checklist ticked P2 with a one-paragraph note of what the part covers and which openings stay air.
polish: Club doors (dark_oak_door at x63 z20 y1..2 and range doors x56/x70 z16..17) and all club windows (range x53,55,71,73; gable x60,66; wings z3,6; courtyard x60,66 z9) are still air for P5 to fill with grilleWindow/archDoor.

Gable front: my front wall runs to y9 (x59..67, z20..21) and the oculus ring is at y7..9 on z21, but the roof is laid before this part (after the shells part), so any roof cells already there in that triangle are refused. Check the club roof (P3) leaves the oculus ring and front wall cells clear and the gable triangle sits on the wall.
Cannons, the entrance ramp, the courtyard centre planting (x62..64 z4..6) and the lanterns are not built here (P5/P6 as plan says).

make.sh's roof line flags OFF-PALETTE stairs in roof.json (deepslate_tile_stairs, tuff_brick_stairs, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, polished_deepslate_stairs). That is the museum/barracks roof spec, not this part, but it needs fixing before delivery.
$MCD walk reports walkable end to end: false, which is expected until the doors are placed; the club cannot be entered until P5 adds them.

waste.what: Worked out every stuccoWall openings list cell by cell (windows, doors, arch, oculus, courtyard gate) from the OPENINGS table by hand.
waste.cost: about 40 cells listed by hand, two rounds of rewriting the list after reading the table
waste.tool: A helper that takes the OPENINGS rows as data (for example stuccoWall(..., {openings: "club-range-front"}) or a holes-by-face table) would turn the reserved-cell table straight into the open set and stop coordinate arithmetic per module.

waste.what: Placed the arch (stairs at x62/x64, keystone at x63) and the arcade gap heads at x58/x68 with individual g.set calls, and found by check that the x58/x68 heads were orphans until I added the y4 beam cells.
waste.cost: about 12 single-block sets, one rebuild and check round to catch the orphans
waste.tool: A vocab helper archHead(g, x0, x1, y, z, {material}) covering an opening's arch, keystone and beam ends, and arcadeBay taking a trailing one-cell gap, would have made this one call.

waste.what: Chose each groundCourse footprint by hand from the plan's plot table (range, gable overlap, arcades, wings, courtyard) and worked out overlaps so the calls do not double-write.
waste.cost: 7 groundCourse calls with coordinate reasoning, no retries
waste.tool: A footprint-union helper, or a plan.json field listing each module's ground footprint, so the parts stop re-deriving the ground boxes.

waste.what: Checked the shell by eye from zoom and front-elevation renders, since no tool scores the club's closure or the arcade read.
waste.tool: mcd zoom with --from and the existing check output were enough; a per-face opening census vs the plan table would have caught a missing window automatically.

companions.task: Build the entrance arch and keystone and the arcade arches (the stair springs and the flat heads at x58/x68) with a proper arch template, instead of hand-setting each stair.
Own the club's gable triangle over the front wall (y8..9 at x59..67, z20..21) and the oculus clearance, so the roof and the front wall agree before the roof is laid.
Fit the deep-set grilled windows (iron bars outside, gray glass inside) into the range, gable and wing openings, and the arched entrance glazing.
Plant the courtyard centre (x62..64 z4..6) and the shrubs along the courtyard walls, and lay any courtyard paths on the paving.

summary:
Roofs, dormers, chimneys: Roofs part built: museum roof from roof.json, barracks main and wing hips, Officers' Club gables and wings, Visitor Center hip and porch roof (all polished granite, palette-clean), 8 dormers, 4 cold stacks, and the club arcade lean-tos, all laid with keep boxes clear.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the roofs read as red hipped and gabled roofs in the render. Still open: a 26-cell Visitor Center back-eave gap and orphaned slabs at the club's overhang edges.
Plan checklist ticked for P3 and a note added to plan.md's Notes.
polish: Visitor Center north eave course at y4, x79..86 z1: 26 roof stairs refused because the shell's VC ring has air at that course, so the hip's back eave is one course short. Fix in shells.mjs (VC brickBlock top course) or accept the gap.

Club roof overhang edges leave 21 orphan slabs (spruce_slab and polished_granite_slab at x50/76 z19..20 and x58/68 z17/23, y5..6): the club shell (part 2) is still a stub, so they hang off air until its walls land; re-run check after part 2 and trim any that still stick out.
Dormers (8) and stacks (4) and the roof keep boxes were built, but `$MCD fit` and the dormer/stack close-up tiles were not checked for lack of time.
Elements.md items 6, 7, 8, 17, 19 are built but not ticked there; only plan.md's P3 checkbox was ticked.

Roof spec keys that caused trouble were not reported to the roof tool's author: a soffit override (even polished_granite) moves the whole build by 1 in runParts; `contrast` must be false or the roof swaps to ALT_ROOF blocks (deepslate, tuff, cobbled), so roof.json needs texture:false, contrast:false, soffit:false and no verge/fascia spruce default.

waste.what: Found the roof-option combination that keeps the red tile palette and stops the one-cell shift by trial: edited roof.json and re-ran make.sh once per key (texture, trim, soffit, hips, contrast) and read the OFF-PALETTE lines each time.
waste.cost: about 8 full builds (about 3 s each) plus 5 Python edits to roof.json, all to learn which option defaults pull in deepslate, tuff, cobbled, spruce or shift the site.
waste.tool: `$MCD roof build.nbt --spec roof.json --dry-run` should list every material a roof would take from a default (alt, soffit, verge, fascia) and which key shifts the footprint, with the fix named, so the trials are not needed.

waste.what: Worked out each roof's footprint from the plot walls by hand: overhang grows the footprint, so the rectangles had to be inset by 1 for club and Visitor Center roofs, plus each keep box for the dormers and stacks.
waste.cost: about 12 coordinate sets computed by hand; one roof (the wings at z 0..6) would have run into the main wall.
waste.tool: A roof helper that takes the WALL footprint plus an overhang and returns the roof rect, and that reads the shell's cells to set the keep boxes for dormers and stacks from a list of dormer/stack positions.

waste.what: Dormer and stack placement relied on hand-counted x/z lists copied from plan.md; no check that each dormer sits inside the roof slope or clears its keep box.
waste.cost: 8 dormer and 4 stack calls written from the plan table, checked only by make.sh, not by fit.
waste.tool: `$MCD fit` or a dormer check that reports dormers whose cheeks sit off the roof surface.

companions.task: Build the Visitor Center north wall top course at y4 (x79..86, z1) so the hip's back eave has a course to sit on, instead of leaving 26 refused stairs.
Set the club's overhang-edge slabs (x50/76 z19..20, x58/68 z17/23) so they sit on the walls part 2 will build, and tidy the arcade lean-tos' bottom edge.
Check the four cold stacks against the flue rule (solid through the roof, cap one step out) and confirm each stack's cells are in the keep boxes.

summary:
Porches, ramps, banners: Porches, ramps, banners (parts/porches.mjs): museum porch z15..17 and barracks porch z14..16 (posts, beams, decks, roofs, railings, red_wool panels), VC porch posts z8 and deck, ramps and handrails at museum x10..13, barracks x35..38, VC x84..87, DISNEY and MUSEUM banner runs.
Built into the shared kit: make.sh saved a whole build.nbt (648 blocks from P4, 0 refused, 0 off-palette); mcd check shows 0 floating; fit OK; zoom renders read as the museum and barracks porches.
plan.md checklist ticked for P4 with a NOTES entry; elements.md rows 9, 10, 11, 16 (porch and ramp), 30 tagged as built.
polish: Barracks doors (element 16's doors) and the museum entrance doors: P5 doubleDoor, not mine.
Visitor Center porch roof and the VC 'PRESIDIO' sign band and banner letters: P3 and P5.
Porch lanterns under the gallery deck (y3) and porch roof (y6): P6 hangLantern.
Visitor Center porch deck is laid by my groundCourse at x80..91 z7..8; the VC porch was checked only by zoom, not by a dedicated VC render.
mcd approach was not run: its syntax needs --from and --to, and I ran out of the session window before running it. The ramps are in the plan's RESERVED cells, and fit reported nothing on the slabs.
The brief says the front faces north; plan.md says south and I followed the plan (render --front s).

waste.what: Porch end bays with no post (museum x0, barracks x24) had to be written by a local openCell helper, because porchBay always puts a post at its first column.
waste.cost: about 20 lines of hand-written cell placement and one retry
waste.tool: porchBay opts.post: false (or a span that starts at the wall line) so an end bay is one call

waste.what: Working out the rail:false/lowerRail:false bays for the red_wool panels and the ramp gap, and mapping each panel cell by hand against porchBay's post/rail cells.
waste.cost: a few coordinate passes, about 4 bays
waste.tool: a porchBay opt listing gap cells ({ gaps: [[x0,x1,'rail'|'lower']] }) so the ramp opening and panel cells come from one spec

waste.what: bannerRun centres the word on the bounding box of the word span AND the panels, not on the x0..x1 span the caller gave. I could not tell from the code whether DISNEY sits exactly on x2..7 without a render.
waste.cost: one zoom render to confirm the letters
waste.tool: bannerRun should centre on x0..x1 and take panels as an extension, with the box stated in its comment

waste.what: The porch deck ground course is not in P1's shells groundCourse list (it stops at the wall line), so each porch deck has to be laid by the porch part.
waste.cost: one groundCourse call per porch, found by checking the built nbt
waste.tool: plan.md SITE should say which part lays the porch decks; groundCourse could take a porch footprint list

waste.what: Visual check of each porch by zoom render, one call per porch, and reading the tile by eye.
waste.tool: mcd card --layout eye or a per-part tile list, so a porch review does not need separate zoom calls

companions.task: The black polished_blackstone_wall rails and handrails at the museum ramp (x9 and x14 at z18) and the barracks ramp (x34 and x39 at z17), plus the cannon barrels, which I'd want set to the iron dimensions the plan gives.
The hanging lanterns under each porch's gallery deck (y3) and porch roof (y6), one per porch bay, so the porch is lit and no dark cell spawns mobs.

summary:
Glazing, doors, signs, cannons, flag: parts/fittings.mjs builds all P5 glazing: sash windows on every OPENINGS window cell of the museum, barracks, club and Visitor Center, grilled club windows, four doors (3 double, plus club singles and the arch door), the oculus, the VC red fascia with PRESIDIO banners, a VISITOR CENTER signboard, two cannons and the flagpole.
make.sh runs whole with no REFUSED writes and no OFF-PALETTE blocks from this part; `mcd fit` is OK; a zoom shows PRESIDIO reads correctly from the south.
Open risk: the VISITOR CENTER signboard (mount [84,4,7]) sits in the eave and porch-roof cells that P3 owns (roof y5 at z7, porch roof y5 at z8..9), so the merged build will refuse those cells. Its text is also unverified.
polish: VISITOR CENTER signboard at mount [84,4,7] (board at z7 y4..5, wall-sign row at z8 y5) collides with P3's Visitor Center eave (y5, z7) and porch roof (y5, z8..9): those writes will be REFUSED in the merged build. Move the mount under the fascia or drop it, and check the text reads (not verified).
The signboard is built from spruce wall signs and a spruce fence bracket, which are not in palette.json (only the board was moved to smooth_quartz to clear the palette check).

Oculus (63,8,21) is built in P5 because the PARTS list gives it to P5, but elements row 20 gives it to P2. If P2 fills the ring with stucco, these writes will be refused; P2 must leave x62..64 y7..9 z21 air or the owner must settle it.
Dormer glass (museum x4,9,14,19; barracks x28,33,40,45; VC x85..86 y6 z6) is left to P3's dormer() helper, not placed here.

Club gable windows are 2 tall (y2..3); the plan's y2..4 is not met. The arch stairs at (62,3,21)/(64,3,21) are facing north, and an extra club courtyard door at (63,1,9) facing north was added from the OPENINGS table.
Visitor Center end windows are at z3 only (the plan says z3..4). Barracks wing windows and wing-end windows have no sills, because a sill would fall off its plot.
Museum back opening into the pavilion (x11..12 y1..2 z7) and the pavilion's own glass door at z1 are left as air for P1; no door was placed there.

Partial-build floats (club grilles and arch, VC red band) are expected: the shell (P2) and porch (P4) are not in this copy, so they will be supported after merge. A full render of the merged build has not been done.

waste.what: Listed every sashWindow call by hand from the OPENINGS table (about 110 windows, each with its face, x, y and z), and worked out each face's sill and out-of-plot cases one at a time.
waste.cost: about 40 minutes of hand loops, plus 3 failed runs and reading source to learn the sill rule.
waste.tool: A `openings` helper in vocab: give it the OPENINGS table as data (face, x list, y rows, z) and it places sashWindow/grilleWindow/doubleDoor, with a sill-in-plot check built in.

waste.what: Worked out the signboard and bannerWord geometry by trial: which cells the wall sign and board take (its z+1 row and roof-cell clash), and that the board material is only palette-clean as smooth_quartz_slab.
waste.cost: 3 build runs and a zoom render; the clash with P3's roof was only spotted by reading signboardPlan's source.
waste.tool: signboard should accept a footprint or palette list and report the cells it would write before committing, so a clash with another part shows up at design time.

waste.what: Per-face sash placement needed a sill-free variant (glaze) for faces whose outward sill falls off the plot, which sashWindow does not offer.
waste.cost: one local helper, plus checking the sill rule in the vocab source.
waste.tool: sashWindow opts: { sill: false } or an automatic in-plot sill check.

companions.task: Set the VISITOR CENTER sign's mount and text so it fits under the eave and reads from the street, and confirm the PRESIDIO banner is legible in a front render.
Lay the club's arched entrance (arch stairs and springing at y3, the door in the inner cell) and the oculus surround, so the arch and ring are built in one pass with P2's stucco.
Own the dormer glass cells (museum, barracks and VC) so the window glazing and the dormer lids come from one hand, not from both P3 and P5.

summary:
Grounds and light: Grounds and light (parts/grounds.mjs) builds 6 museum shrubs (z18..19, clear of the ramp), a courtyard oak at (63, 5), 14 standing lanterns in the ground-floor interiors of the museum, pavilion, barracks, wings and Visitor Center, and hangLantern calls for every porch bay (y3 under the deck, y6 under the roof). make.sh saved a whole build.nbt, Grounds line shows no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE. Ground-floor light is 1 or higher everywhere it is placed (min 1, dim cells only on the lawn edge outside).</summary>

polish: Porch lanterns are not placed in this copy: hangLantern returns 0 until the porch deck (y4) and roof (y7) exist, so the museum (x3,7,11,16,20 at z16) and barracks (x27,32,36,41,45 at z15) lanterns at y3 and y6 appear only after the merge. Check after merge.

Club lanterns are not placed in this copy: the arcade (x52,55,71,74 z19), the range (x55,61,67,72 z12), the wings (x54,72 z5), the gable hall (x61,65 z18) and the VC porch (x84,88 z7) skip standing because the y0 block under them is air until the club and porch parts merge. 14 lanterns were placed in total.
The courtyard oak at (63, 1..4, 5) floats here because the club's ground course is not in this copy yet; it stands on the paving after merge.

Arcade lanterns stand on the arcade paving at y1 (z19), not hung under the beam: the beam's underside is solid arch stairs at y3, so there is no hang point. This departs from the plan's 'arcade lantern per bay under the beam'.

Upper storeys (museum and barracks at y4+, the gallery and the Visitor Center's half storey) have no floors in the plan, so they are not lit here. Ground-floor light is complete: min 1 and dim only on the lawn outside, with no dark floor cell in the buildings.

Lawn edge is only the shrub row (z18..19); the plan's separate lawn-edge block is not built. There is no door-to-gate-to-street walk, no gate and no lamp posts along a path: the plan has no path element, so that is for a later part.

elements.md has no tick column, so it is not ticked. Item 14 (shrubs) is built, item 25 (courtyard tree) is built but needs the club paving, and item 29 (lighting) is partly built and depends on the merge. Plan.md's checklist: P6 ticked.

waste.tool: A `mcd room --lanterns` or `mcd light --suggest` mode that returns the fewest lantern cells holding every floor cell at 8+, plus a `lamps(g, plot, {y})` helper that places them with the support check built in.

companions.task: After the porches and the club's ground course merge, confirm the 10 porch lanterns (museum x3/7/11/16/20 at z16; barracks x27/32/36/41/45 at z15) hang at y3 and y6, and place the 4 club arcade lanterns, the VC porch lanterns at (84,1,7) and (88,1,7), and the club range, wings and gable lanterns.
Lay the walk from the museum ramp and the club's gate to the street (2 wide, slab steps, a level landing) and the lamp posts along it, plus a lawn edge that is more than the shrub row.
Check the club courtyard's smooth stone paving at y0 under the oak at (63, 5), so the tree's trunk stands on a block.
